name: Walboomers Music
summary: An Amsterdam-based independent music company working across hip hop, reggae, Latin and world music.
description: Founded in 1996, Walboomers Music started in physical music distribution before expanding into recordings and publishing. The company later increased its focus on artist management and publishing.

name: Beggars
summary: An independent music group bringing together 4AD, Matador, Rough Trade, XL Recordings and Young.
description: Founded in 1977, Beggars grew into an independent group of record labels. Its current label family includes 4AD, Matador, Rough Trade, XL Recordings and Young.

name: Delsin Records
summary: An Amsterdam record label focused on techno, house, ambient and experimental electronic music.
description: Delsin Records is a Dutch electronic music label founded in 1996. Its catalogue spans techno, house, ambient and experimental music.

name: Universal Music
summary: A major music company with a global family of record labels and music businesses.
description: Universal Music Group is a global music company with a range of recorded-music labels. This directory profile refers to the Universal Music entry in Bridge’s existing directory.

name: Sony Music Entertainment
summary: A global recorded music company whose label family includes Columbia, RCA and Epic.
description: Sony Music Entertainment is a recorded-music company based in New York, with a label network including Columbia Records, RCA Records and Epic Records.
